excerpt.zh: 正当我们的采矿站在这颗被捕获的小行星上完工几天之后，这枚岩石突然开始旋转起来，在这个过程中摧毁了采矿站，但同时又有更多的稀有水晶矿藏暴露在了我们的传感器面前！
excerpt.en: Just a day after finishing our mining station on the trapped asteroid, the rock abruptly rotated, destroying the mining station. In the process of doing this, even more rare crystals deposits were exposed to our sensors!

texts.zh: 正当我们的采矿站在这颗被捕获的小行星上完工几天之后，这枚岩石突然开始旋转起来，在这个过程中摧毁了采矿站，但同时又有更多的稀有水晶矿藏暴露在了我们的传感器面前！
texts.en: Just a day after finishing our mining station on the trapped asteroid, the rock abruptly rotated, destroying the mining station. In the process of doing this, even more rare crystals deposits were exposed to our sensors!

label.en: When a mining station is built again

texts.zh: 警报的笛声响彻整个[Solar_System.GetName]，大量的晶化野兽从小行星庇护所里面冲了出来，正是我们在钻孔并打算提取晶体的那颗小行星。它看上去生气了。
texts.en: Warning sirens blared across [Solar_System.GetName] as the massive crystalline beast left the shelter of the asteroid we had been drilling into and extracting crystals from. It seems angry.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是一颗奇怪的小行星，它似乎可以通过未知的方式旋转并躲开我们的开采站。我们需要委派一艘科研船去研究它。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is a strange asteroid that seems to be able to rotate and avoid our mining station through unknown means. We should dispatch a science ship to discover how.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗小行星。
note.en: In the game, this asteroid appears here.

texts.zh: 这个被捕捉的小行星，实际上，是某种晶态生命体的巢穴。很庆幸我们没有继续挖掘，因为看上去我们似乎激怒了在里面休眠的生物。如果我们什么都不做，只是从远处研究它，这些生物应该会平静下来。
texts.en: The trapped asteroid is, in fact, a crystalline being's nest. It is good that we didn't keep digging, for it seems like we agitated the creature hibernating inside. If we do nothing for a while and study it from afar, it should settle down.

label.en: What can we learn from it?

summary.text:
# 无法解释的旋转 / Unexplainable Rotations

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 沉睡水晶小行星（行星旗标sleeping_crystal，anomaly_events_4.txt:3141）上首次建成采矿站时6880触发（仅一次）。  
  Fires (once) when the first mining station is finished on a sleeping-crystal asteroid (planet flag sleeping_crystal, anomaly_events_4.txt:3141).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 6880：a拿矿（+100矿物，d_rare_crystals_4，拆除采矿站）；b研究→项目STUDY_SLEEPING_CRYSTAL→6890“沉睡水晶巢”（d_society_5、晶体装甲科技进度）。不论选项，事件后旗标由sleeping_crystal变为annoyed_crystal。  
  6880: a takes the ore (+100 minerals, d_rare_crystals_4, station dismantled); b studies it → project STUDY_SLEEPING_CRYSTAL → 6890 (d_society_5, crystal armour progress). Either way the flag changes from sleeping_crystal to annoyed_crystal afterwards.
- 之后若再次在该星体建采矿站，6885触发（仅一次）：生成敌对水晶实体舰队。  
  If a mining station is built there again, 6885 fires (once) and spawns a hostile crystalline entity fleet.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 6880的a/b互斥；6885是两者之后的可能后果。  
  a/b of 6880 are exclusive; 6885 is a possible consequence after either.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
